# 1.2.122 - the rest of the audit of 1.2.118, rechecked on 1.2.121: windows that follow the world while they stand open, a second GM's actions carried out by the primary, a hidden stash and a secret project's time kept off players' browsers, an Observe that tells nothing before it is paid, Listen and the camera dock that keep the veil, the murder's clean-up and tracker that follow the incident, and the auditor's leftovers

One stage ships: E122 (tools/stages.json). It carries every finding of the audit of 1.2.118 rechecked on 1.2.121
(audit/findings-1.2.118/recheck-121.json), the leftovers of the lines, the auditor's unrouted list
(sections A to D; docs/dev/stg-122/UNROUTED.md) and the items of the auditor's probe 43 on 1.2.121, in one update (the
owner's decision). Built by thirteen lines: TEXT, CORE, TRIAL, INVEST, MAP, DESP, UI, STG, WORLD, ITEMS, COMM, R1 (branch
refresh-120) and MURDER, the auditor's branch, and the assembly's own commits. **E39, E40, E43, E53, E58
and E83 are not shipped**, planned 1.2.123. E26 stays 1.3.0. From v1.2.121 (the tag) to b3317e7f, the assembly's last
commit before this release commit: 225 commits, 30 of them merges of the lines and the auditor's branch into the
assembly (`git rev-list --count` and `--merges --count`).

In plain words. Everything below is read off the code and the headless harness; none of it has run on a real Foundry or
at a table (## Checked).

**The veil and the masks** (the audit's check of 1.2.121, lane M; COMM-42; STG-100).
- Listen and its Reroll no longer name or count a killer veiled for the opening on the listener's screen; a GM, the
  killer's own player and the killers' side hear the room as before (action-listen.mjs `heardIn`; reroll.mjs
  `listenLines`; r121-M-1).
- A room action no longer shows a masked character's name to the student who used it; it reads "?" (facilities-gm.mjs
  `applyEffects`; r121-M-2).
- A killer who reveals themselves is named again on the cards every connected GM serves, not only on the cards of the GM
  who ran the reveal. A GM who was not connected at the reveal still shows "?" (mask-gm.mjs `endMask`; secret.mjs
  `forgetHeldMask`; r121-M-3; scenario 97 K4).
- A killer hidden by the opening's veil no longer counts as somebody present on the victim's own sheet, in Palm and in
  the Project briefing (sheet-actions.mjs `roomBlockFor`; action-briefing.mjs; mask-gm.mjs `seenHere`; r121-M-4; R8433).
- A GM's view of a Monocub's panel shows a masked student's Bounty and Ghost Bet by name; the copy the Monocub's player
  gets still reads "?" (monocub.mjs `cubPanelLines`; r121-M-5).
- A Spectator's camera dock shows a masked killer's name, as the Spectator's map already did (camera-view.mjs
  `maskRuleOf`; r121-M-6; R8280).
- With the voice tile off, the camera dock takes a hidden participant's whole box off, not only the name plate
  (camera-view.mjs; COMM-20's rest).
- On the voice tile a killer behind a "?" reads "Hidden" instead of "Disconnected" (voice-tile.mjs `voiceWord`; COMM-42;
  R8262).
- The sequence boards and the voice tile can draw the masked "?" portrait (vault-store.mjs `safePortrait`, mask-gm.mjs
  `MASK_IMG`; STG-100; R8300).

**What a player's browser no longer holds or learns** (CORE-25, ITEM-38, CASE-33, ROLL-20, COMM-22, TEXT-29, MAP-02,
MAP-18, MAP-19, MAP-21).
- A hidden stash is no longer readable from a player's console: which rooms hold one, and whose, is kept by the GMs and
  sent only to the stash's owner (and the Mastermind). The world-secrets check now reads every room's region, so a hidden
  stash written back where every browser reads it fails the suite's check, the canary scenario and the GM's own check
  (hidden-stashes.mjs; gm-stores.mjs `hiddenStashStore`; CORE-25; R9, R190, scenario 72-canary).
- A secret project's completion time is no longer in data every player's browser holds; it is the GMs' row's
  (projects-secrecy.mjs `liftSecretProjectMarks`; ITEM-38).
- Observe no longer lets a player learn, before paying, whether a room holds a Remnant: the target step answers alike for
  an empty room and a room with a trace, and an empty room is ruled by the GMs after the roll, as before. An Observe asked
  and not paid for leaves nothing on the GMs' side, and a Reroll of an Observe in an empty room updates the GMs' card
  instead of adding a second one (observe.mjs `chooseObserveTarget`, `resolveObserve`, `scoreObserve`; CASE-33 and its
  two rests).
- A player's "dice look" report shows only rolls that player may see (dice-look.mjs `rollMessage`, `readableBy`;
  ROLL-20).
- An arrival notice (a stash gone through, a bedroom's note) no longer names the other players who walked in
  (doors-gm.mjs `tellBedroomNotes`; arrival-notices.mjs; COMM-22).
- The death card sent during an incident tells the incident's players who died and no longer carries the GMs' notes
  (death.mjs `killCharacter`; secret.mjs `wordsFor`; TEXT-29).
- A token walking between two rooms that do not touch is no longer shown in the gap before it reaches your room
  (visibility.mjs `slideHeld`, `applyToToken`; MAP-02; R8350).
- Moving a body into a room no longer marks that room as found on the class's map or a Spectator's (fog.mjs `seedCells`,
  `reactToMove`; movement.mjs `isCorpseToken`; MAP-18, MAP-19).
- Dragging onto an unexplored room no longer names it when a seal or another student's bedroom stops you (movement.mjs
  `crossingVerdict`, `restrictedFrom`; MAP-21).
- Handing over a Truth Bullet to someone who already holds it now says only "Nothing changed hands; your Truth Bullet
  stays yours.", not what the recipient holds (handover.mjs, `DRPG.Handover.alreadyHasIt`; TEXT-09, TEXT-LC2, the
  auditor's 3.4-04; R8070, R8461).

**Players' sheets and windows**.
- A character sheet keeps an Ultimate being typed when the sheet redraws, and closing the sheet saves it; a Background
  somebody else changed while you typed is saved when you close the sheet, and you are told (sheet-sidebar.mjs,
  `DRPG.Sheet.biographyChangedClosed`; REFR-10, STG-12).
- Open sheets follow the room: Palm, Tamper, Rifle and the stash sections update when someone walks in or out, a stash
  changes, or a room's lock changes; locking player resources and a GM's Level Up offer update open sheets at once
  (sheet-inventory.mjs `redrawRoomSheets`, `roomSignature`; clock.mjs `refreshSheets`; REFR-11, REFR-12, REFR-14,
  STG-13, UI-34; R8424, R8425). Palm's two pickers and Rifle's list follow the table while they stand open, the pick kept
  (palm.mjs; stash-reach.mjs; REFR-52).
- The Level Up picker follows the sheet while it stands, the pick kept; a player's picker says when its offer went, and
  its Apply then sends nothing. Level Up's menu follows the offers: an offer spent or taken back takes its row with it,
  and the confirm says the row checked (level-up.mjs `wireForm`, `openAdvancementFor`; action-menus.mjs `chooseVariant`;
  REFR-52, CTRL-21).
- Tail Someone's list of whom to follow follows the room; a target who walks out between the GM's last look and the
  rolls costs no action (action-tail.mjs `performTail`; REFR-20; R8382).
- The Projects action window updates while open, and the proposal's room list no longer names rooms you have not
  explored (action-project.mjs; action-menus.mjs; REFR-36, ITEM-25).
- The Call pickers' lists follow the world while they are open (call-pickers.mjs; calls.mjs `confirmCall`; REFR-17).
- A Gear dragged onto a sheet beside one stowed now goes into the hand, as the module's own roads already did (ITEM-04).
- A bystander's minutes line stops during a pause in an incident (hud-elapsed.mjs `shownClock`; UI-21; R8420). The
  Eclipse button's tooltip and each student's opening whisper count the crossings that Eclipse will really give, and
  the whisper no longer mentions sealed rooms (hud.mjs; overflow.mjs; eclipse.mjs `startEclipse`,
  `eclipseAllowanceFor`; UI-18, UI-22, UI-26; R8429).
- While an incident hides the clock, a bystander's screen no longer plays the day's boards when the GM moves the clock
  (transitions.mjs `onClockHeard`; incident-store.mjs `clockHiddenHere`; STG-06; R8500).
- A Spectator's sheet has the safeword button again, and a Spectator's safeword press posts the card even with no GM
  connected (sheet-mode.mjs `sheetMode`; spectator-ui.mjs `isSafewordCard`; STG-04, UI-25; R8430). Two presses of the
  safeword open one confirmation (safeword.mjs `safewordDialog`; COMM-55; R8107).
- A player cannot open a token's settings (token-hud.mjs `refuseTokenConfig`; H-3; R8421; not read on v14).
- A note or a chat message typed in the conversation window is kept when you switch between Chat and Note
  (messenger-app.mjs `DrpgMessengerApp`; CTRL-13, CTRL-24, REFR-53).
- The messenger's read state is each login's own on a shared browser: a GM reading a thread no longer marks it read for
  a player who logs in after on the same browser (messenger.mjs `readMap`; COMM-23; R8112). A message from a sender whose
  clock runs behind still arrives unread (messenger.mjs `READ_SKEW_MS`; COMM-15; R8283).
- The voice tile names who holds the floor (voice-tile.mjs; COMM-27). The settings window's microphone note gives way to
  the microphone list once the browser allows it, and the Voice section's push-to-talk line follows the binding
  (voice-panel.mjs `voiceFieldset`, `followTheMic`; REFR-55; R8284).
- Contraband now tells the owner which item was destroyed, and a refused Hope Call says so once (call-effects.mjs
  `destroyItemEffect`; calls.mjs; COMM-36, COMM-37).
- A Monocub's Ask for Hope gives at most 2 (monocub.mjs `answerHopeAsk`, `ASK_GIVE_MAX`; COMM-21's rest). A Bounty that
  would pay a Monocub no Hope stays open instead of being used up for nothing (monocub.mjs `claimBounty`; DESP-23,
  DESP-29). The season reset no longer rings the Monocub sound (monocub.mjs `setMonocub`; COMM-48).

**Stained Glass and the look** (UI-LC4, UI-09, UI-11, H-1, H-7, MAP-20, COMM-32, CTRL-28).
- Under Stained Glass every word on a window that took the time of day's colour - table heads, headings, the Ultimate,
  the GM panel's next step, the handbook's bold words - is now Bone, so it reads over a bright map; the colour stays on
  the glass's edges and marks (stained-glass.css, components.css; UI-LC4; R8437, R1462 changed on purpose).
- Under Stained Glass the Item tables window's delete buttons and the Projects window's destructive icon write their
  words in the light red, which reads on the glass (they were the dark red, 2.9:1) (components.css
  `--drpg-kit-role-destructive-ink`; UI-11; R8436).
- Only a character's own sheet takes the Stained Glass sheet size; Daggerheart's character settings window and
  Configure Ownership keep their own size and resize handle (window-scale.mjs `isCharacterSheet`; UI-09; R8435).
- Token HUD: under Stained Glass with high contrast a hidden or locked token's button shows its icon, and the keyboard
  focus ring shows inside the hexagon (danganronpa.css, stained-glass.css; token-hud.mjs; H-1, H-7; R8431).
- Under Stained Glass the Map's chapter label, zoom, legend and node fields are drawn at the theme's text size
  (stained-glass.css; audit/case-map-sweep.mjs `sizes`). The Investigation footer keeps each word whole in a narrow
  window, read in Chromium at 600 to 1120 px (components.css; audit/case-map-sweep.mjs `word`).
- A floating text field on the zoomed case map keeps the text size it showed (float-text.mjs `scaledFace`; COMM-32;
  R8506; audit/float-zoom.mjs in Chromium).
- The case Map's Fit to view shows the whole case however far it has to zoom out (the owner's request, 21.11.2026): a
  case too wide for the view at 25% fits at its own zoom, down to 5%, and the zoom buttons and the wheel stop at that
  fit instead of pulling the view back to 25%; a case that fits at 25% or more keeps 25% as the floor (case-view.mjs
  `fitCamera`, `zoomFloor`, `wireCaseCamera`; R8542). Read headless only; how a 5% map reads is not looked at in a
  browser (item 831).
- The room outline no longer bounces under Reduced motion (fog-reveal.mjs `landOutline`; MAP-20; R8341).
- The Despair overflow caption's tooltip now shows on desktop, and the + button no longer spills over the maximum
  (despair.mjs `adjustDespair`; CTRL-28, DESP-25; R8380; audit/caption-hit.mjs).

**Two GMs: a second GM's action is carried out by the primary** (CORE-22, MAP-40, COMM-29, DESP-21, STG-76).
- A GM's own twelve Infiltrate and room actions (facility use, the four door actions, watch, tail, eavesdrop and its
  stop, Echoes, the mask's reveal, Dash) run on the primary GM, so a second GM's action reaches the players as the
  primary's does; a GM playing a student through the Infiltrate rows is told what happened (the doors, the watch, a
  Dash), as a player is (bridge-asks.mjs; bridge-guards.mjs `createWaiter`, `localRun`; CORE-22, ROLL-22; R8109;
  scenario 97 K5).
- A GM who is not the primary no longer writes the Search Tokens on their own browser: Room setup's - and +, the refill
  at a change of the time of day and a rewind's take-back are written by the primary GM, so they no longer overwrite a
  Search spent in the same moment (search-tokens.mjs `gmWriteOnPrimary`; MAP-40; scenario 33 A24).
- Play and Stop the track work on every GM's browser: another GM's press is carried out by the primary GM's browser.
  Stop the track says what it did (music-play.mjs `playTrack`, `resetMusic`; sound-panel.mjs; the bridge action
  `music.track`; COMM-29, COMM-50, the owner's decision; scenario 97 M1, M2).
- With two GMs, a Despair Call is paid only once the primary GM has taken its price; the "Rolls with no GM connected"
  card updates for every GM and is posted only once (despair.mjs `spendDespairCall`, `routeToPrimary`; roll-draw.mjs
  `settleAwayCards`; DESP-21, DESP-28, REFR-19, ROLL-28). The way that card was decided travels with its words to the
  GMs, not on the card's document every browser is sent (found by scenario 15's world check in CI on the release
  commit; secret.mjs `updateSecret`). A Monocub's price, refund and Redeem, and a Bribe's payment,
  read the Hope the GMs hold (monocub.mjs `cubHopeHeld`; DESP-26).
- The case summary goes out as one card per trial however many GMs press Send, and a summary whose card was not made is
  not marked sent and the GM is told (case-summary.mjs `showCaseSummary`; trial-progress.mjs `summaryClaimStep`;
  `DRPG.CaseSummary.notSent`; STG-76, CASE-73).
- An Observe aimed before the primary GM changed is still resolved by the new primary (observe.mjs; gm-stores.mjs;
  CASE-LC3; scenario 62 Q1). A find waiting on the GM's describe window is no longer lost if that GM reloads: it goes
  out under its prefilled name, and the other GMs are told while it waits (observe.mjs `describeFind`,
  `recoverDescribing`; CASE-37's rest).
- A notice asking a GM for a ruling closes once another GM has ruled it, and no longer carries buttons that did nothing
  (popup.mjs; REFR-16, CTRL-22).
- End the chapter tells a GM who is not the primary at once and keeps the window (gm-campaign.mjs; CTRL-86; R8100).

**GMs' windows follow the world while they stand open** (the owner's rule "Zawsze odswiezamy okna od razu przy zmianie";
the audit's REFR findings; the check of 1.2.121, r121-R-1 to r121-R-11).
- A live window no longer saves half-typed text when it redraws while the GM is typing, and no longer closes a dropdown
  list the GM has open: it redraws once the list closes. The dropdown part is read in Chromium only (live.mjs
  `replaceQuietly`, `guardWindow`, `oweChange`; r121-R-1, r121-R-3; R8540; audit/live-redraw.mjs).
- Room setup: a token count typed while the window redraws lands as typed; Apply no longer turns a lock forced while
  the window was open into the room's start lock; "Remove the picture" shows only on a room that has a picture
  (room-setup.mjs `startLocksAtOpen`; components.css; r121-R-2, r121-R-5, r121-R-11).
- The Season checklist: a press on one of its buttons is no longer lost when the checklist redraws under it, and its
  rooms-per-student line follows a death or a revival while the window stands open (season-setup.mjs `relistRows`,
  `repaintStep`; r121-R-7, the auditor's probe 43; R8541, R8117).
- The game's settings and this browser's settings show a change made elsewhere at once, and Save writes only what you
  changed in the window (settings-window.mjs `followSettingRows`, `saveSettings`; CORE-27, REFR-28, STG-15; R8101).
- Edit campaign and Season setup no longer put back a time of day or a safeword changed while one of their questions
  stood open, and Edit campaign keeps the fields it held when it calls off an assembly first (gm-campaign.mjs
  `untouchedKept`, `KEPT_FIELDS`, `applyCampaignForm`; REFR-02's rest, REFR-06, D162; R8100).
- Season setup's scenes part follows another GM's links while it is open, keeping your own unsaved ticks
  (trial-scene.mjs `wireScenesTab`; REFR-73).
- Open trial windows (Findings, Logic Dive sets, the vote window, the console's schema) update at once when another GM
  or the game changes them, and an open ballot closes when its vote is counted (trial-zones-ui.mjs `openFindings`,
  `openDiveSets`; trial-floor-ui.mjs `openVoteDialog`; case-trial.mjs `liveSchema`; vote.mjs; REFR-43, REFR-68,
  REFR-69, REFR-71, REFR-72, CTRL-09, STG-20, STG-24).
- The Eclipse's placement table, the readiness window and Look inside the stashes update while open (boundary.mjs
  `placementTable`, `roundWindow`; stash-reach.mjs `openVaultInspector`; REFR-08, REFR-13, REFR-49).
- The explainer windows (clock, Despair, action strip, Projects) update while they are open (explain.mjs `explainer`;
  CORE-30, REFR-24, REFR-56).
- The status strip, the handover picker, End the chapter, the Passages tab and the rules manager's motive update at once
  (player-status.mjs; handover.mjs `askWhoIsHere`; chapter.mjs `refreshChapterEnd`; passages-tab.mjs; rules.mjs; UI-20,
  REFR-22, REFR-23, REFR-31, REFR-40, REFR-59).
- The Item tables window follows its tables: an entry added, renamed or removed in Foundry's own table window or by
  another GM shows at once, a field being typed in keeps its words, the counts follow, and Rename takes a room's split
  tables with it (tables-editor.mjs `renameRoomFamily`, `freshTableCounts`; CORE-33, REFR-57, CTRL-70).
- The room-action editors (a room's and a project's) follow another GM's save while open, and keep what was typed and
  the focus (facility-editor.mjs `followSaved`; REFR-58, CTRL-71).
- The Mastermind window updates while open: a Mastermind or room another GM sets shows at once, the Give Hope box
  appears without reopening, and Apply only saves what you changed. A room can be chosen before the Mastermind
  (mastermind.mjs; REFR-45, the rest of r120-F-6, CTRL-48).
- Despair Flow's Save only writes what you changed there, so another GM's pool names, assignments and Overflow rules
  survive; its suggested Overflow threshold follows deaths and revivals while the window is open, the typed threshold
  kept (gm-team-dialog.mjs `saveGmTeam`; REFR-07, REFR-26, UI-19, ITEM-37, the auditor's probe 43).
- The Project manager redraws when projects are made, moved, renamed, shared or deleted elsewhere, and ticking Secret
  unlocks the player ticks (projects-ui.mjs; REFR-32, REFR-35, REFR-62, CTRL-74).
- Give a Truth Bullet's Remnant list, the Autopsy's list, the case window, the restore preview, the Back up question and
  Give back follow the world while they stand (REFR-09, REFR-51).
- The Give button of Give a Truth Bullet and of Give an Item keeps its tooltip once it may be pressed; the check that
  paints the gate took it off (gm-items.mjs `holdGive`; found by scenario 95 in CI on the release commit).
- The Sound window's two switches and its "no playlists" note follow another GM's changes at once (sound-panel.mjs
  `wireSoundSwitches`, `musicEmptyBox`; REFR-25; R8282).
- Give / take on a student's sheet opens the item window on that student even when it was already open on someone else
  (CTRL-20). Create an item on a card fills the item tables even when they are already open, unless a new item is being
  typed there (messenger-app.mjs `ruleCreateItem`; tables-editor.mjs `openItemTables`; CTRL-25).

**GMs' buttons that say why** (the audit's CTRL findings).
- On the Investigation Map, Check consistency, Place on the map, the fold and a Table filter save what you typed first,

- The trial console says why a button is greyed (Show summary, Finish the verdict, Nonstop Debate, a schema tile's

- Despair Flow's Split evenly asks first, and the projects tray's Delete asks first (gm-team-dialog.mjs,

- The GM panel's Next time of day waits while an incident runs and has not reached Stage 6, and says why (boundary.mjs

**The murder's rules** (line MURDER; the audit's CASE, CTRL and REFR findings of the incident, r121-K-1, r121-K-3).
- A cover roll's critical during a clean-up gives its 1 Sanity back on the GMs' side, once, for a roll the GMs drew,
  and no longer shows up as an unexplained refund (cleanup.mjs `concealFromWitnesses`, `takeCoverRefund`,
  `coverGiveBack`; CASE-27). The give-back on Stage 6's two keys is in place but not driven by a test.
- The crisis menu follows the incident while it stands: a turn passed to the other side, or the incident's end, closes
  it and says so (action-murder.mjs `openCrisisMenu`; action-menus.mjs `keepRowsLive`; REFR-21). The GM's incident
  tracker follows Silence now, the killer's readied Cleaning Tool and the opening's answer, keeps the GM panel's wait
  when it reopens itself, and its End the murder question goes when another road closes the incident (murder-ui.mjs
  `openIncidentTracker`; murder-rules.mjs `askWhileIncident`; CTRL-80, REFR-63, REFR-38, CASE-22, CTRL-81, REFR-39).
- A trace left where the murder happened stays tied to the crime after the body is moved, and one left beside the
  moved body is no longer tied by itself (remnants.mjs `placeRemnant`; death.mjs `recordSecretDeath`; CASE-74).
- Cancelling a change of who left a Remnant puts the old name back on the open card, even if the card redrew meanwhile
  (remnant-ring.mjs `wireCardEditing`; CTRL-19).
- With two GMs, the opening's veil is always set by the primary GM, held to its own declarations (bridge-runs-acts.mjs
  `handleMaskVeil`; mask-gm.mjs `veilOnPrimary`; the bridge action `mask.veil`; STG-31; scenario 97 V1, V2; scenario
  30's forged packet).
- Several incident questions close themselves when the incident moves on: the after-incident checklist moves no phase
  it did not offer, Body found's "Whose body?" shows a death recorded while it stands, a discovery that reaches its
  witnesses while the GM's prompt stands is asked by the same prompt, and a held Key fee's card offers its charge only
  for its own chapter (murder-rules.mjs `afterIncident`; body.mjs `openBodyDiscoveryDialog`, `askPendingBodies`;
  key-remnants.mjs `wireChargeHeld`; REFR-41, CTRL-79, REFR-65, CTRL-34, CASE-67, REFR-67, STG-30).
- A death of the running incident is known to its own seats alone; a second body the same day leaves an earlier
  betrayal offer standing and tells the GMs; with two killers, "the victim ran out" is asked once; a murder is not
  opened on a student already dead to the GMs (incident-store.mjs `incidentKnowers`, `armBetrayalWindow`;
  murder-rules.mjs `checkVictimSpent`, `openMurder`; CASE-21, CASE-25, CASE-23, REFR-37).
- The clean-up's rules: a bystander may lay a false trail at the victim, a seat may not; Move the Body asks where the
  body lies, not where its Monocub walks; a Tamper's card names the trace by the roller's own copy; a refused erase is
  passed on, not answered as done; a Reroll puts an erased trace back as it stood; Approve on a reshape whose Remnant is
  gone settles the card and says so (cleanup.mjs `framingCandidates`, `bodyIsHere`, `resolveEraseRoad`;
  cleanup-reshape.mjs `recreationDataFor`, `applyReshapeRuling`; bridge-runs-acts.mjs `handleCleanup`; CASE-30, CASE-32,
  CASE-28, CASE-59, CASE-31, CTRL-55).
- The Key Remnant count holds only the slots that hold one, inside the case's own count, so a case of three or four
  can read "every Key Remnant found" (key-remnants.mjs `keyPlanStatus`; CASE-29). A season reset that keeps the plan
  keeps only that chapter's schema and Logic Dive sets (key-remnants.mjs `keepSeasonKeyPlan`; CASE-52).
- The tracker's Ask for the opening roll again is offered for a death by the student's own hand and says what it did;
  after a trap's victim has noticed the trap the tracker offers no second roll; Direct Murder's declaration opens its
  briefing's Details (murder-ui.mjs `reaskOpening`; murder-rules.mjs `resolveVictimOpening`; action-murder.mjs
  `performDirectMurder`; CTRL-32, CTRL-77, CASE-57, CTRL-30, CTRL-31, STG-65).
- A third whose Escape Together fails in a trap is not sent the killer's Leg; the watches' dice held at the Eclipse's
  end are let go when the end throws before the lights (murder-rules.mjs `announceCrisis`; eclipse.mjs `endEclipse`;
  watch-gm.mjs `releaseTheLights`; r121-K-1, r121-K-3). A freed victim's player who asks for the incident's closing card
  on return gets their own line (secret.mjs `holdWordsFor`; CORE-23, STG-26).
- Keep Watch's start card and a critical tail's card name no Spectator, and the improvised weapon is written in the
  world's document language (watch-gm.mjs `namesIn`; tail-gm.mjs `standingIn`; murder-rules.mjs
  `grantImprovisedWeapon`; ITEM-21, TEXT-21).
- The GM panel's Clear Faint Remnants question is gone: no control opened it since E64, and End the chapter clears
  Faint Remnants (remnants.mjs; CTRL-56). The Cleaning up window stays a console road, `game.drpg.cleanupDialog` (the
  owner's decision of 21.11.2026).

**The trial** (line TRIAL; CASE-14, CASE-38, CASE-46, CASE-62, CTRL-02, CTRL-33).
- A player with no token in the trial hall is asked to pick a side for each Logic Dive question; closed by mistake, the
  window comes back after 15 seconds (zone-machine.mjs `diveQuestion`; trial-zones-ui.mjs `PICK_AGAIN_MS`; CASE-46,
  CTRL-06, CTRL-07, REFR-44, STG-17, STG-18, STG-25; R8140; scenario 68 W2, W3).
- Keep speaking hides "Your turn" for 20 seconds instead of for the whole turn, and the window shows the seconds you have
  left (trial-prompt.mjs `KEEP_SPEAKING_MS`; CASE-38, CASE-64, CTRL-03, REFR-66; scenario 67 K1 to K3).
- With the trial console closed, the GM panel's next step says when the Closing Argument is waiting on you to confirm or
  pick its speaker, or to decide who continues (trial-floor.mjs `TRIAL_NEXT_STEPS`; CASE-62; R8148).
- In the trial console's case schema, pressing a node opens the case's Map on it (case-trial.mjs `liveSchema`; CTRL-02;
  the auditor's unrouted C).
- The vote's "still to vote" list names a player handed a ballot who then disconnected (vote.mjs `pendingVoters`;
  CASE-14).
- With anonymous sheets switched off, Take from the Body is still on a dead student's sheet (anonymity.mjs
  `myCharacter`; CTRL-33; R8147).

**The investigation and the opening roll** (line INVEST and CORE; CASE-19, CASE-24, CASE-55, CASE-LC2, r120-P-4).
- A second body found while the first planned Autopsy goes out gets its own planned Autopsy (case-realize.mjs
  `sendPlannedAutopsy`; CASE-55).
- A counter's dashed line back across several columns now goes around the nodes between (case-view.mjs `routePlan`;
  the rest of r120-P-4; R8181).
- The GM panel's next step during the Investigation reads "all keys found" against the case's own Key count when it has
  one, not only against the planned rows (gm-panel.mjs `keysAllFound`; CORE-19; R8116).
- A player whose browser reloads during an opening roll is offered the roll again; this is read off the code, not
  measured on a reload. The guard against a second window holds one window per side and character, so a GM's browser
  throwing one character's opening still opens another's. An opening-roll invitation that arrives before the player's
  browser has the incident waits for it, and the GMs are told if it never comes (murder-rules.mjs `throwOpeningRoll`;
  `DRPG.Murder.openingNoCopy`; CASE-24, CASE-24 narrowed, CASE-LC2; R8103, R8183; scenario 61 F9c).

**Rooms, doors, actions and their prices** (lines CORE, MAP, DESP, WORLD).
- A barricade comes down, and a Pick the Lock way in ends, when its character is moved out of the room by any road - a
  gathering, the trial, a GM's drag - not only by walking out (crossing-settle.mjs `onTokenStood`; doors-gm.mjs
  `barricadesLeftBy`; lockpick-gm.mjs `passLeftBy`; STG-08, STG-09, ITEM-20).
- A barricaded door no longer opens for someone who only knows a secret passage nearby (movement.mjs `barricadedFrom`;
  MAP-22).
- Refund last crossing leaves the token where it is if it has moved on since, and tells the GMs where it stands
  (movement.mjs `refundLastCrossing`; MAP-25).
- An unseen Frisk refused before its rolls are read now gives its action back, as a Steal and a Plant do (frisk.mjs
  `performFrisk`; palm.mjs `handBackIfRefusedBeforeRolls`; CASE-34, ITEM-27).
- Echoes, and a murder parked or a betrayal declared in an Eclipse, asked by a player, run only on a payment of that
  character's that the primary GM saw; one without it is refused (bridge-runs-acts.mjs `claimedFor`,
  `handleParkMurder`, `handleBetrayal`; CORE-21's rest; R8115; scenario 61 P3a).
- Rerolling Force the Door or Keep Watch no longer tells the rooms twice, leaves a second Remnant, or loses the Sanity
  cost (infiltrate-reroll.mjs `settleForce`, `settleWatch`; ROLL-23, ROLL-24). A Reroll that loses a Work's critical
  takes back what the GM saw pay, an action or a Burst; a GM's own free Work takes back nothing (reroll.mjs
  `settleActionRefund`; roll-draw.mjs `drawnPayment`; ROLL-25).
- The death window's "keep it for the GMs" box follows the student you pick (death.mjs `openDeathDialog`,
  `keptFollowsChoice`; CASE-43).
- `game.drpg.migrate({ force: true })` no longer sets a default world's safeword or gives back removed bedroom stashes
  (migrate.mjs `seeds`, `migrate1_2_0`; CORE-26).

**Texts** (line TEXT; STG; the assembly).
- A dead student's sheet says that with separate voice in each room they talk in the Spectators' room, which the living
  do not hear (lang/en.json, lang/pl.json; STG-29; R8060).
- A Cleaning Tool's description says how it helps each clean-up: advantage and its tier on an erase or a reshape,
  advantage on a Misleading Trail, its tier on Move the Body (config.mjs; TEXT-20; R8061).
- A player whose Truth Bullet cannot be copied is no longer shown the GM's restore path; the GMs get it in their own card
  (handover.mjs, trial.mjs, `DRPG.Handover.answerKeyMissingGm`; TEXT-32; R8063).

- The Rot's card says stashed items wear down too, and Behind Closed Doors says Force the Door or a breach lifts the seal
  (TEXT-31, TEXT-23; R8060, R8061).
- Texts made consistent: Search Tokens, Repair an Item, Close the Breach, Tamper, and Polish forms; three long tooltips
  shortened (TEXT-27, TEXT-33, TEXT-34, TEXT-35, TEXT-36, STG-90; R8060, R8061, R8064).

- The notice history's "Show new notices" tooltip says it takes you up to the new notices (r121-R-8; R8060).

  and project tokens. Bedroom keys, looted Truth Bullets and project tokens are now written in the world's document

## Before installing

- **Two migration clauses are added** (scripts/migrate.mjs, both `since: "1.2.122"`), run once on the primary GM:
  `liftHiddenStashes` moves each hidden stash out of its room's region into the GMs' store and its owner's copy
  (hidden-stashes.mjs), and `liftSecretCompletedAt` moves a secret project's completion time into the GMs' row
  (projects-secrecy.mjs `liftSecretProjectMarks`). Headless only: the tier 2 tests "1.2.122 CORE-25" and "1.2.122
  ITEM-38" lift a world from before; no world from 1.2.121 has been migrated on a real Foundry. A clause marked `seeds`
  no longer runs again under `migrate({ force: true })` (CORE-26).
- **Two settings are registered** (`game.settings.register` on 202 lines of scripts/ at v1.2.121, 204 here):
  `gmHiddenStashes` and `mineHiddenStashes`, neither shown in Configure Settings. **One GM store is added**:
  `hiddenStashes` (gm-stores.mjs `hiddenStashStore`), with each owner's copy (`hiddenStashCopy`).
- **Language**: lang/en.json goes from 6413 to 6508 keys: 104 added, 9 removed (`DRPG.Items.takeFrom`;
  `DRPG.Panel.seasonChecks`, the old Pre-season checks label, whose checks live in Season setup, TEXT-40; and the seven
  keys of the Clear Faint Remnants question, CTRL-56), 44 changed. lang/pl.json goes from 7510 to 7597: 106 added (the
  English additions and the Polish `.few` and `.many` forms), 19 removed (the same keys with their Polish forms, and six
  unread Polish texts of config.mjs's actions, TEXT-25), 71 changed. Counted on the flattened files, v1.2.121 against
  b3317e7f.
- No glyph added (icons/ has no change; tools/glyphs.json's three rows of the token HUD's glyphs change their record
  only, H-6). No console name changed (tools/api-surface.json has no change in the range).
- **Daggerheart**: `verified` stays 2.12.9. **Foundry**: module.json's compatibility has no change (minimum 14.364,
  verified 14.365); the owner's sandbox runs 14.370, which module.json does not name.
